faqData.question: What time should I arrive?
faqData.answer: Please arrive at least 30 minutes before the program start time. This allows time for parking, seating, and getting settled.

faqData.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faqData.answer: Plus ones are welcome if they were included in your invitation. Please check your RSVP for the exact number of guests.

faqData.question: Is there a dress code?
faqData.answer: Yes, the dress code is casual/semi-formal attire in dusty blue, navy blue, and cream colors. We want everyone to feel elegant and comfortable.

faqData.question: Are children welcome?
faqData.answer: Yes, children are welcome! This is a family-friendly celebration.

faqData.question: What type of food will be served?
faqData.answer: We will be serving a buffet dinner with multiple options. Please indicate any dietary restrictions when you RSVP, and we'll do our best to accommodate your needs.

faqData.question: Is there parking available?
faqData.answer: Yes, the venue has parking available. On-site parking is provided for all guests.

faqData.question: Can I take photos during the event?
faqData.answer: Yes, feel free to take photos! We'd love for you to share your memories. Please use our hashtag when posting on social media.

faqData.question: What's the best way to RSVP?
faqData.answer: Please use the RSVP button on our website. You can also contact us directly if you have any issues with the online RSVP system.
